review_candidates.title: Google Ads Specialist (Freelance Project Collaboration)
review_candidates.description: Project Overview I am looking to collaborate with an experienced Google Ads Specialist on a lead-generation campaign for a technology training business in Nigeria. The business offers technology training programs, including Full-Stack Software and App Development, AI Automation and Agentic Systems, Growth Marketing, Creative, and AI Search. The target audience includes students, graduates, job seekers, working professionals considering a career change, entrepreneurs, and individuals looking to acquire technology skills for employment or business growth. The primary market is Nigeria, particularly Lagos, with potential to reach suitable learners interested in online training. Project Objectives The campaign is expected to: Generate relevant, qualified enquiries from prospective students. Drive registrations for the selected training programs. Encourage enquiries through WhatsApp, phone calls, and the website. Increase relevant website traffic and brand awareness. Establish a measurable advertising framework that can inform future campaigns. Scope of Work I am looking for a specialist who can independently assess the project requirements and recommend the most suitable Google Ads strategy, rather than simply execute a predetermined campaign. The engagement will cover the following: 1. Campaign strategy and research Assess the training offer, target audience, geographical reach, and competitive landscape. Conduct keyword research and evaluate search intent, competition, and estimated click costs. Recommend the most appropriate Google Ads campaign type or combination of campaign types. Develop realistic budget scenarios based on estimated traffic, lead volume, conversion rates, and campaign objectives. 2. Account audit and conversion tracking Review the existing Google Ads account and advertising readiness. Assess existing Google tags, Google Analytics 4, and Google Tag Manager configurations where applicable. Verify or implement suitable conversion tracking for website enquiries, WhatsApp clicks, phone enquiries, and completed registrations where technically feasible. Identify any website or tracking issues that could affect campaign measurement. 3. Campaign setup and launch Configure the agreed campaign structure, targeting, bidding strategy, keywords, ad groups, and exclusions. Develop or advise on effective ad copy, headlines, extensions/assets, and calls to action. Recommend appropriate landing pages and identify any changes needed to improve lead generation. Set up campaign budgets, location targeting, and relevant audience settings. Conduct pre-launch checks and confirm that tracking is functioning correctly. 4. Handover and documentation Provide a clear summary of the campaign strategy, account configuration, targeting decisions, and budget assumptions. Document the campaign structure and key settings. Explain the initial optimization priorities, performance indicators, and recommended next steps. Provide a handover session to support the person responsible for ongoing campaign management. Expected Deliverables Initial account and tracking audit. Keyword research and campaign strategy. Recommended campaign type and structure. Budget scenarios and lead-generation forecasts, with assumptions clearly stated. Campaign setup and launch, subject to account access and client approvals. Conversion tracking configuration and testing, where feasible. Ad copy and targeting recommendations. Handover documentation and a walkthrough session. Engagement Structure This is a defined project-based collaboration focused on strategy, implementation, launch, and handover. Ongoing monthly campaign management will be handled separately. Please indicate your proposed fee, estimated timeline, deliverables, and any additional costs that may arise from the project. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate should have: Demonstrable experience setting up and managing Google Ads campaigns for lead generation. Strong knowledge of Google Search Ads, keyword research, bidding strategies, and conversion optimization. Experience promoting education, professional training, technology, or similar services is an advantage. Practical experience with Google Ads conversion tracking, GA4, Google Tag Manager, and website event tracking. The ability to develop realistic advertising budgets and explain the assumptions behind lead forecasts. Strong analytical skills and the ability to distinguish between clicks, enquiries, qualified leads, and actual registrations. The ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and provide a structured handover. How to Apply Please send a brief proposal including: Your relevant Google Ads experience and examples of comparable campaigns. Your recommended approach to this project. Your proposed fee for strategy, setup, tracking, launch, and handover. Your estimated timeline and any dependencies. Your experience with conversion tracking and lead-generation reporting. Please share case studies or anonymized results where possible. I am particularly interested in candidates who can explain their approach, justify their recommendations, and demonstrate practical experience beyond campaign setup alone.

review_candidates.description: Career Opportunities: Global Foundations Manager (14162) Requisition ID 14162 - Posted 10/09/2026 - Nairobi - Full Time  Job Description Print Preview Are you looking for a meaningful job where you can invest your skills, passion, and time in an impactful way? Do you want to work for an organization that is dynamic, goal-driven, and dedicated to making a difference? Welcome to Welthungerhilfe! Welthungerhilfe (WHH) is one of Germany’s largest private aid organizations. Politically and religiously independent, we work toward a world without hunger. Together with national and international partners, we respond to humanitarian crises and support long-term solutions that improve the living conditions for the most vulnerable people. We change and shape food systems, we are locally-led and globally connected. As an impact-oriented and human-centered organization, we use innovation, evidence and data-informed decision-making to continuously improve our work and contribute to #Zero Hunger. Our vision: "Zero Hunger on a Healthy Planet." Join us in creating a world where everyone has access to food while ensuring a sustainable future for our planet. If you are ready to make an impact, we look forward to receiving your application! Global Foundations Manager* in one of the WHH country offices in the African continent The position is to be filled as soon as possible, with an initial contract duration of 2 years. There are very good prospects for an extension. The role is based in one of the WHH country offices in the African continent and will work with WHH country offices worldwide. Candidates should apply for a duty station in a country where they are currently legally authorized to work without employer-sponsored work authorization. Please note that the position does not offer visa or work permit sponsorship. The final duty station will be based on the selected candidate’s existing right to work in the respective country. As Global Foundations Manager, you will help diversify Welthungerhilfe’s funding base and strengthen long-term philanthropic partnerships that advance our mission of Zero Hunger. The role combines partnership development, internal collaboration, and strategic fundraising. You will develop and manage strategic foundation partnerships and work closely with country offices to establish the processes and structures that enable foundation fundraising. Working closely with colleagues across country offices and the German headquarter, including colleagues already engaging with foundation donors (mainly in Germany and USA), you will contribute to building strong foundation pipelines, developing compelling partnership opportunities, and strengthening approaches to foundation engagement across countries. Alongside this work, you will also develop and pursue selected foundation partnerships directly, particularly with foundations operating regionally or locally in countries where Welthungerhilfe works. In doing so, you will coordinate closely with colleagues worldwide to ensure aligned engagement and a coherent global approach to donor relationships. You will be part of WHH’s Philanthropy & Partnerships team, which is primarily based in Germany, collaborating virtually on a regular basis across time zones. Your responsibilities Work closely with country offices to identify, develop, and advance strategic foundation partnership opportunities. Collaborate with country teams in building and managing strong foundation prospect pipelines, identifying opportunities that align with programmatic priorities and funding strategies. Accompany country offices in the cultivation and development of foundation partnerships, including donor outreach strategies, engagement planning, and partnership positioning. Contribute to developing partnership pitches, concepts, and cases for support together with country teams, translating programmatic priorities and impact evidence into compelling foundation-facing propositions. Facilitate exchange of successful practices, market insights, and fundraising approaches across country offices to strengthen the organization’s overall capacity to engage foundations. Identify and pursue selected strategic foundation opportunities, particularly with regional or locally present foundations, in close coordination with relevant country offices and head office colleagues. Coordinate closely with WHH colleagues wordwide to ensure aligned relationship management and coordinated donor engagement. Develop high-quality pitches, concept notes, proposals, and partnership propositions in collaboration with technical experts, program and country teams. Support due diligence processes and risk assessments for prospective foundation partners in line with Welthungerhilfe’s policies and compliance requirements. Your profile A Bachelor’s degree required; a Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g. International Relations, Nonprofit Management, Development Studies, Marketing, or Communications) is strongly preferred. At least five years of progressive experience in foundation fundraising or institutional philanthropy, ideally within an international NGO or global development context. Demonstrated ability to secure six- and seven-figure grants from foundations and manage long-term donor relationships. Strong analytical and strategic skills to translate complex programmatic information into compelling, impact-driven funding propositions. Experience using donor relationship management systems (e.g., Salesforce or equivalent) to maintain a structured partner pipeline and monitor engagement. Excellent interpersonal and networking skills with the ability to build trust and collaborate effectively across cultures, functions, and levels of seniority. High degree of independence, organization, and reliability, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a dynamic environment. Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and adapt strategies to evolving philanthropic trends. You recognize the growing value of data in your field and are eager to build your awareness and skills to incorporate data-informed approaches into your work. Exceptional written and verbal English skills, with proven ability to develop persuasive, donor-oriented proposals and reports. Proficiency in additional languages is an asset. What we offer Fair Compensation: A fair and equal remuneration based on a transparent salary scale. Commitment to Well-Being: We attach great importance to our duty of care with a focus on safety, security & health. Modern & Agile Work Environment: Be part of a forward thinking organization that fully embraces digitalization and innovation across all areas. Personal & Professional Growth: Access diverse learning and development opportunities to advance your career. Team: Join our dedicated and diverse teams, where passion, expertise, and joy come together to create a better world. In addition, Welthungerhilfe offers numerous other benefits, which you can find under Our benefits . Please send your application via our online recruiting system by October 27, 2026. Your contact person is Sarah Liem-Hartmann. Welthungerhilfe is committed to fighting terrorism in all its activities. Accordingly, any applicant who is offered employment will be screened against lists of known and suspected terrorists. Welthungerhilfe values diversity and ensures an inclusive, non-discriminatory working environment. We welcome applications from suitably qualified people from all sections of the community. Our Benefits Find Out What Benefits Welthungerhilfe Offers For Employees. Our Projects We fight against hunger and poverty by implementing projects in numerous countries. review_candidates.description: Position Description The theory group of IFAE (Barcelona, Spain) at the UAB Campus (Barcelona, Spain) invites applications for one to two postdoctoral research positions in theoretical developments for searches of high-frequency gravitational waves. The appointments will be for a full-time positions of two to three years. The positions will start in Fall ****. About GravNet And The Theoretical Physics Group These positions will be funded by the ERC-****-SyG GravNet ******** (GravNet: A Global Network for the Search for High Frequency Gravitational Waves), /. GravNet is dedicated to optimizing the searches for high-frequency gravitational waves in a network of electromagnetic cavities, or other setups to be conceived during the project. All aspects, from source characterization, response of detectors, network distribution to sensing strategies (in particular leveraging quantum sensing) are being revised, with the goal of building the most precise detector to high-frequency gravitational waves in the near future. GravNet is led by PIs Diego Blas (IFAE/ICREA, Barcelona), Dima Budker (U. Mainz), Claudio Gatti (LNF, Italy), and Matthias Schott (U. Bonn, Germany; leading PI). The successful candidates will join the GravNet-IFAE group, in charge of developing and optimizing all theoretical aspects of the proposal. This includes the complete modeling and simulation of the response of the detectors to gravitational waves of different sources, generating realistic sensitivity calculations and exploring different network configurations. These results will be used to design the best strategy for GravNet to detect high-frequency gravitational waves. Other detection strategies will also be explored. The candidates should have research expertise in Theoretical Physics, and experience in theoretical work dealing with searches of BSM physics or gravitational waves physics in laboratory set-ups (in particular with quantum sensing techniques) is particularly welcome. The successful candidate will be part of the Beyond the Standard Model and Astroparticle Physics and Cosmology groups of IFAE (/). The staff members of the group are D. Blas, E. Masso, A. Pomarol, O. Pujolas, M. Quiros, F. Rompineve, E. Salvioni and A. Wulzer. Candidates should include a CV, a statement of research interests, a publication list (with the URL of the INSPIRE-HEP or another similar repository in the first line) all in PDF format, and 3 Reference Letters. The candidates will be evaluated on the basis of their scientific research excellence, adequacy to the project and an interview for the short-listed candidates. The application deadline will be December 31st, ****. The acceptance deadline for the selected candidates will be set in agreement with the "High-Energy Theory Postdoc Deadline Accord". About IFAE The Institut de Física d'Altes Energies (IFAE) is a public consortium of the Generalitat de Catalunya, the Autonomous Government of Catalonia, and the Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona (UAB, a public university) whose main objective is to carry out research and to contribute to the development of high-energy physics from a theoretical, experimental, and technological point of view. IFAE has the status of a "University Institute" attached to the UAB, and its premises are within the campus of the University. Applicants should have a PhD in Physics or related topics by the start of the contract. For further information, please contact: Diego Blas (******). Sending applications implies the candidate's consent to IFAE to treat their provided personal data according to the current Spanish and European data protection regulations. IFAE is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace and social integration of people with a disability. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates. People from groups that are typically underrepresented in the labour market in general, and in Science and Engineering in particular, such as women, minorities, or people with a disability, are particularly encouraged to apply. #J-*****-Ljbffr
